common_contract.transport: Use the existing public numeric C ABI and chem_analyze dispatcher. Return one JSON object containing both numerical plot data and an SVG string; callers can extract the string into a .svg artifact. Dedicated SQL aliases can be added only with complete argument documentation and actual loaded-extension tests.
matrix_columns: value: finite number; if observed=0 this is an ignored finite placeholder, not a missing-value imputation
group_id: exact integer in[-(2^53-1),2^53-1], groups displayed in ascending numeric order
observed: 0 or 1; explicit missingness flag because the existing ABI cannot carry nullable numerical cells
row_id: unique nonnegative exactly representable integer <= 2^53-1 for output provenance
common_contract.sample_selection: For each group, analysis uses observed=1 AND excluded=0 AND frequency>0. Hidden alone stays in numerical summaries but suppresses individual row markers. Report physical row counts and frequency totals separately, plus excluded/missing/zero-frequency/hidden counts. Do not expand frequency into a large data vector. Empty groups return explicit empty status and null statistics; at least one nonempty group is required.
common_contract.missing_input_rule: SQL NULL, NaN, infinity, ragged matrices, noninteger flags/frequencies/IDs, duplicate row IDs and resource-limit violations return public NULL. To preserve a missing data row for report accounting, the caller supplies a finite placeholder with observed=0. Supporting natural SQL NULL values would require a distinct future bridge contract.
common_contract.analytic_weight_rule: No analytic Weight column in the first bounded contract. Requests for such semantics must be rejected or left explicitly unsupported; do not silently use frequency as analytic weight.
common_contract.numerical_safety: All returned numbers and SVG coordinates must be finite. Reject unrepresentable intermediate results/domains instead of serializing NaN/Inf, collapsing a nonconstant range, clipping outliers silently, truncating markers or wrapping counts. Use stable convex interpolation for quantiles and checked/count-safe cumulative frequencies.
output_fields: schema='ducksmiles-cpu-plot-v1', operation, media_type='image/svg+xml', width, height, svg
selection_policy, quantile/bin policy name, applied limits, source-row and replicated-observation denominators
groups with numerical bins or five-number summaries, whiskers/fences, outlier row IDs/frequencies and rendering bounds
explicit implemented_options and remaining_options; no blanket JMP-equivalent flag
common_contract.svg_rules: Self-contained UTF-8 SVG namespace, width/height/viewBox, title/description, deterministic numeric labels and group IDs, explicit plot bounds and clipping, readable axes/ticks, and row/bin provenance attributes. No script, event handlers, foreignObject, external references, network fonts or dependence on GPU/browser execution. Fixed built-in presentation defaults avoid adding a runtime graphics library.

rendering_contract.quantile_outliers: JSON always retains closed-Tukey classifications independent of box_type; quantile full-range style never draws outlier circles; explicit outlier_visibility=not_applicable_quantile.
rendering_contract.state_counters: All state counters independently count source flags, including overlaps. Raw frequency sum limit includes excluded and missing rows.
rendering_contract.geometry: Each nonempty group has panel left/top/width/height and shared value_domain; affine value_origin=domain minimum,svg_origin=left for horizontal or top+height for vertical,value_scale signed pixels/value; stable reconstruction svg_origin+value_scale*(value-value_origin). Conventional value_offset is descriptive; direct scale*value+offset can cancel for large-offset/small-range data. Histogram also response_domain and affine response_scale,response_offset; box group_coordinate,box_half_width.
rendering_contract.axis_labels: Adaptive2..5 distinct numeric ticks per axis: concise5decimal/scientific5digit labels unless they collide, then shortest-roundtrip plain/scientific; tick subdivisions4,2,1 and actual text-width margins adapt. One subdivision always includes both endpoints. Reject only if readable geometry cannot fit. Width estimate7px per character at12px sans-serif.
rendering_contract.box_clip: Shared clip expands panel4px on each side; outlier radius3px and stroke1.5px remain whole, including min/max endpoints; no markers truncated.
rendering_contract.accessibility: SVG title/desc, readable labelled numeric axes and per-bin titles; each box group title retains full-precision five-number,whisker,N statistics even when visible five-number table is off. Five-number option renders a visible labelled table.
rendering_contract.empty_groups: Keep all source groups sorted ascending, status empty, panel null and numerical summary fields null; box outliers empty. Empty groups do not consume plot panels; at least one nonempty group required.
rendering_contract.group_labels: Vertical box band must fit full Group id text plus8px and be at least50px; horizontal box left margin adapts to full Group id. Histogram facet title must fit cell width. At least100x80px plot area; histogram each bin at least2px.
rendering_contract.five_number_precision: Visible table uses concise labels unless distinct values would collapse to the same text; then shortest-roundtrip plain/scientific labels per row. Columns must fit actual estimated label width+8px. Each cell exposes data-role=five-number-value,data-group-id,data-statistic,data-value; hidden title does not replace visible precision.
rendering_contract.canvas: Integer width320..4096 and integer height240..4096; particular options must also satisfy actual readable layout constraints.
